I understand you're looking into your options if a product doesn't work out. We want you to love your Babyletto product, and we have a clear process for returns and exchanges.

For orders placed on Babyletto.com, you can initiate a return within 30 days of delivery. To qualify for a refund, items must be unused, in their original packaging, and include all parts. Please note that some items are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged.

Here are the key requirements for a return or exchange:

  • Return Window: Must be initiated within 30 days of delivery (or 60 days if you purchased Checkout+ Protection).
  • Condition: Items must be in \"like-new\" condition. We cannot accept returns on items that have been damaged after delivery or show significant signs of use.
  • Packaging: Items must be returned in their original boxes with all internal protective packaging, including all parts, pieces, and printed materials.
  • Modifications: Products must not be modified in any way.
  • Shipping: All returns must be shipped to our designated facility in California.

If you purchased return coverage, your return shipping label is covered, and you'll receive a 100% refund of the purchase price once the item is received and processed. If you choose not to purchase return coverage, you can still process a return within 30 days, but you will be responsible for the cost of the return shipping label and any associated return fees.

For exchanges, your new order will ship out after we receive your returned item. You'll receive an email confirmation when your returned item is processed, followed by a new tracking email for your exchange.

Please be aware that certain items are ineligible for return or exchange, such as most bedding products (though you can submit a request for review), specific brands like Newton Baby Mattresses and Organic Crib Waterproof Protector by Avocado, gift cards, and any items marked as “Final Sale.” Mattresses also have specific return requirements regarding their packaging remaining unopened and intact.

You can review our full Return Policy here.

To initiate a return or exchange, please use our Returns Portal here.

If you received a damaged part or are missing a part, we can send you a replacement without needing to initiate a full return. You can submit your request through the Babyletto Parts Form.

Is there anything else I can help you with today?
